name: lucide
summary: UMD browser build of the Lucide open-source SVG icon set, served from unpkg's CDN.
description: unpkg serves lucide.min.js, the UMD bundle of the Lucide icon package (v1.55.0): the icon set as inline SVG data — 24×24, stroke-based, currentColor, 2px stroke, round caps and joins — plus a createIcons() helper that replaces <i data-lucide="…"> placeholders in a page and a camelCase name lookup (CircleCheck, AlarmClock …). Loadable with a single script tag; ISC-licensed.
